notes.title: Ribbit Ranch v0.2.150.0 Update
notes.content:
Added tutorial system that plays upon starting the game for the first time

Added player level and progression system!

Added froggy thoughts! Frogs occasionally have thoughts about how they are feeling!

Added much more feedback to explain why certain actions can not be performed

Added buy max packs functionality! You can now buy the max amount of packs possible in the shop and open they one after another

Added filtering by pond and race proficiency in frog selectors and added proficiency display to the selector buttons

Added support for special frogs to breed, go to pond and race (breeding with special frogs has a slight increased chance for special offspring)

Updated frog lifecycle, all frogs will now start as hatchlings except frogs created from cloning which remains as the egg stage

Added hover sounds for buttons

Updated title splash to be more personalised and appear cleaner

Updated gold text displays on buttons to appear red when you don't have enough gold to purchase something

Hatchlings are now 3x as more active than adults

Improved tank dropdown to better show frog capacity

Re-added ability to purchase growth potions in demo

Added max multiplier for income and growth

Added growth and income multiplier bar displays

Doubled default pellet growth rate

Added more animations for collectables in the tank

Replaced 3 common pattern textures

Fixed clone menu error

Fixed frog icon bug not resetting material to default after displaying a special frog

Fixed bug where frogs will occasionally not move for up to a minute or more

notes.title: Ribbit Ranch v0.2.63.0 Update
notes.content:
Added new type of special frog, the ethereal frog!

Added sizeable window mode option in settings

Added ability to modify glass tint colour for tanks

Glowing frogs now have a special unlit material to make them glow even more!

Added 1 more pattern and 1 more body for frogs

Replaced all environment effects so they are higher quality and have an outline

Updated some backgrounds

Doubled resolution of all backgrounds so they should appear less blurry

Fixed colour discovery bug that caused a variety of issues including the incorrect display of colour discovery progress in Ribbidex menu

Fixed missing transition effects when pressing return from the pond or racing

Various balancing changes

Greatly improved demo based on feedback, the whole demo experience should better show off the game in a much quicker fashion

Minor UI and tooltip improvements across many UI elements

notes.title: Ribbit Ranch v0.2.29.0 Update
notes.content:
Complete overhaul of UI overlays, which now include custom image icons, outlines and overall massive improvements to readability and usage

Improved tank environment, tanks now have a little glass border around the top edges to improve the feeling of the frogs being in a tank!

Added tank glass tapping which scares the frogs and causes them to jump

Improved card backs and added selection outline

Added ability to reveal all cards for packs and discoveries (for those wanting to speed things up)

Improved menus so that titles are larger and contrast better

Added frog locking system, lock your favourite frogs so that they cannot be sold until unlocked!

Added breeding flagging, so that frogs that are the result of breeding now have a little icon showing so in the frog menu

Improved pack splash background to allow for quicker selected after closing a pack

Removed mutations in the demo (sorry!)

Added save button in settings

Updated pond generation to hopefully produce less ponds where your frog can't hop around enough of the map

Pond generation is now affected by the frog's star rating (the higher the rating, the more lily pads that spawn, with a max of 10 extra)

Added particles in the pond that display based on the success of breeding with a pond frog

Added handle to prevent pond frogs from jumping to lily pads they are already on

Added confirmation for returning to the tank when in the pond or racing (Decreases the chance of accidently clicking return and being sent back)

Added language support for German

Added more sound spamming handles for cards

Improved race environment

Replaced race UI with a single unified results menu

Added race timer UI display

Added frog trails to racing (colour determined by primary colour of frog)

Added worldwide leaderboard for fastest player frog times

Race frogs now sleep after finishing a race (aww)

Added display for decoration capacity, pellet growth, income modifier and growth modifier in tank UI (no longer requires you to open the tank menu every time to view these stats)

Removed redundant information display in tank menu and doubled the width of the frog selector to better view all frogs in the tank

Added quick selling for frog selector in tank menu

Added more tooltips where clarification was necessary

Fixed growth multiplier bug that caused the first tank's growth multiplier to be applied to all tanks and not the respective growth multiplier for each tank

Overall decrease in cost for all frog actions of about 10% (breeding, pond and racing)

Increased capped income claiming from 30k to 50k

notes.title: Ribbit Ranch v0.1.457.0 Update
notes.content:
Greatly improved special frog (gold and cosmic) appearance so they appear more special!

Greatly improved both the frog and decoration menu

Improved glowing frog functionality so that special frogs glow their colour and all glowing frogs now glow as eggs too

Added new pellet feeding animations to make feeding feel more fun!

Added more rarity-based UI colours to give frogs more flavour

Replaced outline system, the new system looks almost the same but is far more performant and reliable

Added outline selection system for frogs and decorations when selected

Added star rating system for frogs to more easily understand what frogs are good at what

Updated background shop buttons and added background colour selector to background tab in shop for easier use

Updated pond generation and visuals

Updated milestone reward icons

Updated colour selector so that the selected colour can be seen easier

Updated clearable appearance

Updated frog breeding in the tank so that the offspring are born with stats influenced from both parents

Updated race rewards so winnings grants more race attributes

Updated rarity colour accents

Updated decoration placing

Updated origin icon so that it always displays the origin and is not overridden by special frogs

Added locked UI to leaderboard rankings in demo

Increased growth potion pack of 3 from 250 to 1500

Fixed bug where you could buy potions when you did not have enough gold

Fixed sound spam when selling all frogs or decorations

Fixed rarity icon displaying incorrect information for secondary colour attribute on cards

Fixed race rewards bug which allowed you to claim a pack when not first in the race

notes.title: Ribbit Ranch v0.1.390.0 Hotfix
notes.content:
Updated UI resolution handling (this should hopefully stop inconsistent text sizes across different monitor/screen resolutions)

Updated credits

Added text explanation for cloning in cloning menu

notes.title: Ribbit Ranch v0.1.384.0 Update
notes.content:
Added Cosmic frogs which are even rarer than Golden frogs

Added milestone system with 13 milestones to unlock, when completed they unlock either a background or a decoration in the shop

Added world leaderboard for discovered combinations (for those who are competitive)

Added new collection button which shows total attribute and special collection progress

Added ability to purchase growth potions from the shop in groups of 3

Added feedback button to settings menu (feedback always welcome and encouraged!)

Fixed achievement 10 not being possible

Fixed frogs growing far too quickly when leaving the game running for a while and switching tanks rapidly

Updated unknown icon to stand out more

Added Korean and Portuguese (Brazil) support

Fixed colour changing UI not working after being disabled and then enabled

Replaced some ugly patterns (Tell me which other ugly ones you want me to replace!)

Fixed localisation for some patterns

More behind the scenes work on the demo (coming VERY soon!)


We now have a dedicated subreddit to discuss all things froggy:
https://www.reddit.com/r/RibbitRanch/

notes.title: Ribbit Ranch v0.1.350.0 Update
notes.content:
Added outline to most 2D sprites

Significant UI improvements across many areas

Added simplified Chinese and Japanese support

Increased tank max capacity from 35 to 45

Reverted to single looping soundtrack system

Updated breeding visualiser so that undiscovered combinations appear as unknown

Improved collection menu so that attributes provide a lot more information

Added 4 more tank lights

Added possibility for multiple frogs as rewards in racing

Fixed frog prints sizing to match new frog scale

Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Ribbit Ranch v0.1.297.0 Update
notes.content:
Decreased frog scale by 25% (They should appear smaller and cuter now)

Added tank light system, where different colour lights can be purchased from the shop

Added ability to turn tank light off and on

Updated frog colours so that 15 colours now emit a glow when dark (try turning off the tank light!)

Added glow icon to frog menu to show when a frog has glowing attributes

Removed frog token system, frog rewards (from racing or the pond) will now be automatically redeemed upon returning to the tank

Replaced 4 decorations

Added localisation system

Added Russian support (more languages to come!)

Updated UI to provide more information in some areas

Improved card backs

Added hover animations for cards

Added more UI sounds

Add more UI animations

Improved frog jump animation

Lots of behind the scenes demo functionality (demo on the way!)

notes.title: Ribbit Ranch v0.1.235.0 Update
notes.content:
Added jump animations for hatchling frogs!

Greatly improved frog movement, frogs no longer have to turn before leaping and should feed on pellets a lot quicker now

Added spawn animation for frogs

Frogs now spawn in as each card is flipped, not all at once

Replaced most decorations with much nicer looking versions

Added effects for certain decorations that play when a frog lands on them

Decreased max decoration amount from 40 to 12

Tweaked all decoration multipliers to either apply an income or growth bonus, not both

Updated shop so that it shows when the max amount of decorations have been bought for this tank

Added multiplier bonus display for decorations in shop

Fixed shop menu bug allowing you to buy more than the maximum amount of tanks

Updated unknown icon for frogs so that the origin can also be seen in the corner

Added more UI sounds

Reverted pellet feeding to only apply to the frog that consumes it and not the entire tank

Improved hopping in the pond

Improved hopping speed when racing

Fixed error when attempting to open the clone menu when no frogs have been discovered

Fixed discovery pop up bug appearing when a frog in another tank has been discovered

notes.title: Ribbit Ranch v0.1.187.0 Update
notes.content:
Added jump animations for frogs!

Added eye closing for all current frog bodies

Added golden frogs! Every time you flip a card, it has a small chance of being an ultra rare golden variant of that body type, collect them all!

Added sleeping mechanic for frogs, where completing actions such as going to the pond, racing or breeding will cause the frog to sleep for an hour. While sleeping, further actions with the same frog are not possible

Added frog cloning, where discovered combinations of frog attributes can be cloned for a price, this allows you to clone (almost) every frog you have discovered

Updated pond frog offspring to be eggs

Updated pond breeding menu to display more information about the target pond frog

Heavily improved the visuals and effects at the pond

Improved attribute generation for pond frogs which should result in pond frogs having more pond attributes

Added placement medal effects for frogs as they finish in a race

Added more effects to clearables

Fixed double entry free for racing

Added more UI clearing between scenes

Updated pack visuals for unique origins

Updated pellet sounds

Balanced pellet upgrade cost calculation, (now takes into account other tanks)

Improved tooltips

Fixed overflow bug on high amount of potions

notes.title: Ribbit Ranch v0.1.113.0 Update
notes.content:
Fixed textures on race scene

Added display for when max income redeemable is reached on title screen

Updated frog icons so that rarity is always displayed

Added origin type display to most frog icons

Added frog jump sounds outside of the tank

Added the pond! Select a frog and take it to the pond where it has a chance to breed with special pond frogs!

Added 5 bodies (only acquirable from the pond)

Added 7 patterns (only acquirable from the pond)

Added 8 colours (only acquirable from the pond)

Added scene loading transitions (where necessary)

Fixed clearable bug

Replaced race betting system with upfront cost to streamline the experience and get racing quicker

Improved the income and/or sell values of all non-standard attributes, making non-standard attributes more valuable

notes.title: Ribbit Ranch v0.1.70.0 Update
notes.content:
Attributes are now associated with an origin 

Fixed tooltip bug defaulting to off

Fixed some existing patterns

Fixed overflow text on some UI

Updated collection menu to display more information such as discovery progress and owned frogs

Updated breeding UI to offer more information

Updated frog menu, which now displays icons for special features such as colour changing and mutation status

Updated shop so that upgrades show when they are maxed out and cannot be purchased further

Added frog token system which allows players to win frog tokens that can be redeemed in the shop

Added frog token rewards for racing, where if your frog wins you can choose to take a token instead of gold

Added 5 bodies (only acquirable from racing)

Added 5 patterns (only acquirable from racing)

Added 5 colours (only acquirable from racing)

Added shadows to some decorations

Updated pellet sprite (again!)

Updated tank menu, including adding a quick selector feature

Fixed tooltip bug

Added filters for frog scroll and frog selector to allow for easier sorting

Reduced frog movement activity based on the number of frogs in the tank

Added basic shadows to all frogs

Added more UI animations

Redrew all backgrounds so that they are not tiled are appear much nicer

Improved tank effects

notes.title: Ribbit Ranch v0.1.3.0 Update
notes.content:
Added 3 new bodies

Added 7 new patterns

Added 8 new colours

Slight improvements to camera

Game should now run in background

Enabled achievements

Added hatchling sprites for each body type (so now each body type also has a unique appearance when still a hatchling!)

Improved text input (thanks Kael)

Added live growth bar updating when the Frog Menu is open

Added more settings

Improved tooltips

Added frog racing! Race your frogs against opponents to win prizes!

Updated frog feeding
